spot.html_text: This critique of historicism and holism is balanced, on the positive side, by Popper’s affirmation of the ideals of individualism and market economics and his strong defence of the open society—the view that a society is equivalent to the sum of its members, that the actions of the members of society serve to fashion and to shape it, and that the social consequences of intentional actions are very often, and very largely, unintentional.
